title: mapcn.json
description: Configuration written by `mapcn-rn init` and maintained by the mapcn-rn CLI. Records the renderer, basemap provider, styling system, import aliases, and the components installed into this project.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the mapcn.json format. The CLI refuses to read a config written by a newer version than it supports.

renderer.description: Native map renderer the installed components target.

provider.description: Basemap provider supplying tile styles for the chosen renderer.

id.description: Provider identifier. `carto` requires no API key; `maptiler` and `mapbox` do; `custom` means you supply your own style URLs.

envKey.description: Name of the public runtime env var holding the provider API key, or null when the provider needs no key.

styling.description: Styling system detected in the project. Determines whether installed components use className or StyleSheet.

aliases.description: Import aliases the CLI resolves component file targets against, derived from tsconfig paths.

components.description: Components installed by the CLI, keyed by registry name. Managed by `add`, `diff`, and `migrate` -- edit by hand only if you know what you are doing.

version.description: Registry version this component was installed from.

files.description: Files written for this component, with the content hash recorded at install time. `mapcn-rn diff` compares against these to detect local edits.

path.description: Project-relative path of the installed file.

hash.description: Content hash of the file as installed.
